dependencies.name: Create
dependencies.notes: Compile and runtime dependency for Minecraft 1.21.1. Do not use source or development JARs.

dependencies.name: Create: Aeronautics
dependencies.notes: Required by the Create: Aeroworks 1.5.0 baseline. The official 1.3.2 release is distributed as a create-aeronautics-bundled JAR.

dependencies.name: Create: Aeroworks
dependencies.notes: Targets the official Create: Aeroworks 1.5.0 mod release. Aeroworks modpack version numbers are not valid mod dependency versions.

dependencies.name: CC: Tweaked
dependencies.notes: Default compile and runtime API baseline. The published compatibility range still accepts 1.119.x and 1.120.x.

dependencies.name: Sable
dependencies.notes: Required runtime dependency of Create: Aeronautics and used by the static and moving ship compatibility tests.

dependencies.name: Drive By Wire
dependencies.source: Official Drive By Wire distribution page
dependencies.notes: Optional compatibility runtime. CC-Aeroworks remains compatible with 0.2.9 and adds verified 0.3.x support.

dependencies.name: Create: Radars
dependencies.notes: Optional runtime for Radar Displays registered as native monitor endpoints through the Network Filterer and physical Data Link flow. Gradle resolves CurseForge file 8227753 for local development runs.

dependencies.name: Create: Diesel Generators
dependencies.source: Official Create: Diesel Generators distribution page
dependencies.notes: Development and test runtime for Minecraft 1.21.1. Gradle resolves CurseForge file 8542167.

dependencies.name: Create Big Cannons
dependencies.source: Official Create Big Cannons distribution page
dependencies.notes: Optional dependency used by Create: Radars. Automatically resolved for local Gradle runtimes together with Ritchie's Projectile Library.

dependencies.name: Ritchie's Projectile Library
dependencies.source: Official Ritchie's Projectile Library distribution page
dependencies.notes: Required runtime library of Create Big Cannons 5.11.7. Automatically resolved for local Gradle runtimes.

dependencies.name: Just Enough Items
dependencies.source: Official Just Enough Items Maven repository
dependencies.notes: Development-only recipe viewer automatically resolved for local Gradle runtimes. It is not a published CC-Aeroworks dependency.
